name: How does exterior mobile home trim repair differ from interior repair?

mainEntity.name: How does exterior mobile home trim repair differ from interior repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Exterior mobile home trim repair requires weather-resistant materials and heavy-duty sealants compared to interior trim. Exterior skirting rails, corner caps, and window surrounds take direct exposure to sun, rain, wind, and ground moisture. These pieces must be durable vinyl, treated wood, or composite that will not rot when exposed to outdoor elements. Interior trim work focuses more on appearance, neat mitered joints, and clean caulking, while exterior trim work prioritizes watertight flashing and expansion gaps to prevent leaks from entering the subfloor or wall cavities.
acceptedAnswer.description: Exterior trim requires weather-resistant materials and exterior sealants to keep water out, while interior trim emphasizes precise finish carpentry, caulking, and paint.
